title: WeftOS installation brain: metadata on one entry
description: Every entry an agent writes to its installation's ruvector (RVF) brain carries this metadata (ADR-121 decision 9). Nothing carries between projects unless `scope` is deliberately changed to `promoted`.

kind.description: What the entry is. Project agents working next to a developer write decisions and handoffs.

summary.description: What was decided or found, in one or two sentences.

why.description: The reason, so a later reader can tell whether it still holds.

where.description: Where it applies or can be checked: repository paths, card ids, weftos:// names. Never an absolute machine path.

installation.description: The installation the brain is bound to (a weftos://.../installations/<id> name or its id).

package.description: Digest of the agent package that wrote the entry.

author.description: The package id of the writing agent.

instance.description: The weftos://.../instances/<ULID> of the writing run, when there is one.

card.description: The board card the work belongs to, when there is one.

supersedes.description: Ids of earlier entries this one replaces.

scope.description: `installation` stays in this installation's brain. `promoted` was deliberately offered for reuse by another project.
